product_family: Privacy-first, open-source knowledge base for note-taking and personal knowledge management. Core product includes Logseq (desktop/mobile), Logseq Sync (encrypted cloud sync, BETA), and Whiteboards (BETA). AGPL-3.0 open source.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: RiscLens analysis (March 2026): 'SOC 2 status is not explicitly confirmed. Check their trust center or request compliance documentation.' No confirmed SOC 2 report found in public sources.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found across vendor domain or public compliance registers.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not mentioned in privacy policy, terms of service, or security documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance (regulatory posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy states privacy-first design, but no formal DPA, no data residency statement, and no explicit GDPR compliance statement found. Company does not publish data processing agreements.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or compliance framework. Product is consumer/knowledge-base focused, not healthcare-oriented.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not applicable to knowledge base product.

privacy.ai_training_note: No evidence found that Logseq trains models on customer data. Privacy policy makes no mention of AI training. Third-party AI plugins (OpenAI, Ollama) available but optional and user-controlled.
privacy.data_region: Unknown - not specified in privacy policy or terms

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: End-to-end encryption for Logseq Sync using age algorithm. Data encrypted on device before transmission to servers.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Local storage encrypted on device. On-disk encryption available but deprecated.

security.name: Data Decryption
security.value: Only user's devices can decrypt synced data using password. Company and Logseq servers cannot access unencrypted content.

security.name: Third-Party Services
security.value: Sentry for error logging, Google Play Services for mobile. Users should review those vendors' privacy policies.

security.name: Responsible Disclosure
security.value: Vulnerability disclosure discussion exists on GitHub. However, no formal SECURITY.md policy established.

security.name: Code Audit & Open Source
security.value: AGPL-3.0 licensed, fully open-source, allowing community code review. Community has audited and found issues.

security.name: Recent Security Vulnerabilities
security.value: CVE-2024-4367 (pdfjs-dist XSS), CVE-2024-32472 (excalidraw). Data leakage: encrypted folder contents readable in plain text at ~/.logseq/graphs. Disclosed 18/08/2025, patches not available in release 0.13.

products.name: Logseq (Desktop/Web)
products.data_scope: Local-first by default. Optional cloud sync via Logseq Sync (BETA). Data stored as Markdown files locally.
products.notes: Free open-source application. Available for macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon), Linux, Windows. Whiteboards and Live Queries in BETA. 150+ plugins available.

products.name: Logseq Mobile
products.data_scope: iOS & Android apps with optional sync via Logseq Sync. Markdown-based data.
products.notes: Supports encrypted syncing to other devices. Platform-specific implementations.

products.name: Logseq Sync
products.data_scope: E2E encrypted sync service for multi-device synchronization. Optional service; local-only use does not require it.
products.notes: BETA service. Uses age encryption. Password-based E2EE means only user's devices can decrypt.

products.name: Logseq Whiteboards
products.data_scope: Canvas feature for visual thinking connected to knowledge base. Part of core product.
products.notes: BETA feature. Allows infinite canvas and visual connections between thoughts.

compare.pricing_model: Free open-source application with optional paid Logseq Sync service (BETA). No licensing tiers.
compare.data_residency: Not specified. Appears to use generic cloud infrastructure; no regional option mentioned.

flags: The privacy policy and terms of service are both effective July 23, 2020, about 6 years old as of 2026, with no evidence of updates despite the Logseq Sync launch and product evolution.
Logseq does not publish a dedicated trust center, compliance portal, or security documentation page; trust information on the vendor domain is minimal.
No Data Processing Agreement is published or mentioned. One is required for enterprise and GDPR-regulated customers but is absent.

Security vulnerabilities were disclosed recently: CVE-2024-4367 and CVE-2024-32472 in 2024-2025, and a data leakage vulnerability (graph contents readable in plain text) on 18/08/2025. The latest release (0.13) was unpatched at disclosure time.
There is no formal vulnerability disclosure policy: a GitHub discussion exists, but no official SECURITY.md file.
Logseq holds zero SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, or other formal certifications. Its RiscLens compliance score is 50/100.
The privacy policy makes no statement about where data is hosted or stored, which is critical information for GDPR and other regulated use.
The risk of mistaking this vendor for another company is low: Logseq Inc is verified across multiple sources (GitHub, LinkedIn, funding announcements, Wikipedia).
